description: This file defines the ContactsListViewSmarty class, which extends ListViewSmarty, to customize list view functionalities for contacts, including processing, exporting, and building map links in the SuiteCRM project.

classes.name: ContactsListViewSmarty
classes.description: Custom list view class for contacts extending ListViewSmarty, adding functionalities for processing actions, exporting, and building map links.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the class and setting the targetList property to true.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes the list view, adding confirmation email options if enabled, and manages export link visibility based on ACL permissions.

methods.name: buildExportLink
methods.description: Constructs and returns the export link with embedded JavaScript for Google Maps integration if user has export permissions.
